🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* India's SEBI and RBI
• *Announcement:* India's securities regulator SEBI, alongside the RBI, launched "Demat 2\.0", a pilot to issue and settle corporate bonds as digital tokens, aiming to modernize the \$620 billion corporate bond market\. This initiative seeks to enhance efficiency, reduce settlement times, and potentially lower issuance costs.
• *Market Stance:* 🟢 BULLISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH \(95\% \- This is an official pilot program launched by primary Indian financial regulatory bodies with initial issuances already completed\)\.

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* None
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* IT, Pharma, Textiles, Metals/Auto, EMS, Chemicals, Infrastructure, OGCs, Paints, Aviation \(All sectors may benefit from enhanced capital raising efficiency and improved market infrastructure\)\.
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Inflows \(Increased efficiency and modernization of Indian financial markets could attract foreign investment, easing corporate financing costs, and improving market liquidity and transparency\)\.

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should view this as a positive structural reform improving funding avenues for Indian corporations\. Maintain a positive outlook on Indian equities given this enhancement to overall market infrastructure, particularly for companies that rely on corporate bond markets for capital\.
